description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android TV application. It manages the UI components, handles focus and key events for remote navigation, and performs animations on user interactions.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity serving as the entry point for the Android TV app, handling UI setup, focus, and key events.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and configures focus and animations.

methods.name: onCardFocusChanged
methods.description: Handles focus change events on the card view, applying scale animations.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events from the remote control, triggering animations or activity finish.

methods.name: performSelectAnimation
methods.description: Performs a scale animation on the target view when selected.
